# Membrane AAC FDK plugin v0.18.15 - Table of Contents

> Membrane AAC decoder and encoder based on FDK library

## Pages

- [Membrane AAC FDK plugin](https://membrane-aac-fdk-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-aac-fdk-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.AAC.FDK.Decoder](https://membrane-aac-fdk-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.AAC.FDK.Decoder.md): Element for decoding AAC audio to raw data in S16LE format.
- [Membrane.AAC.FDK.Encoder](https://membrane-aac-fdk-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.AAC.FDK.Encoder.md): Element encoding raw audio into AAC format
